field.name: economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: Economic nexus gross receipts threshold - NJ uses standard $100K threshold

field.name: transaction_threshold
field.comment: Economic nexus transaction count threshold - Default 200

field.name: state_tax_rate
field.comment: NJ base corporate income tax rate - 9% (11.5% for income > $1M with surtax)

field.name: state_additions
field.comment: State-specific additions: federal interest, IRC 199A addback, bonus depreciation, etc.

field.name: state_subtractions
field.comment: State-specific subtractions: municipal interest, state taxes, state NOL, etc.

field.name: state_credits
field.comment: State tax credits: R&D, jobs, film, renewable energy, etc.

field.name: nj_entire_net_income
field.comment: NJ entire net income (NJ term for taxable income base)

field.name: nj_surtax_rate
field.comment: NJ surtax rate (2.5% for corporations with income > $1M)

field.name: nj_surtax_threshold
field.comment: NJ surtax threshold ($1,000,000 entire net income)

field.name: nj_surtax
field.comment: NJ surtax amount calculated (2.5% of entire net income > $1M)
